sections.text: This is My New Year! Soaring Serpent!

-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all allies. Increases max HP by 60% for 120 seconds.
Max HP increasing effect boosted by 10% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 120 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 3 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 120 seconds: Recovers 20% of max HP when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 120 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Resolute Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases max HP by 120%, and increases status ailment resistance by 30) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 80 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +400
